description: How reliable a cloud flow is across its recent runs: failure rate, duration spread (median and 90th percentile), and which actions the failures concentrate on. The verdict distinguishes one broken step from failures spread across many actions, which points at a connection, throttling or an unreliable downstream system instead. Read-only. Use it before cs_explain_flow_run when the complaint is 'it fails sometimes' rather than 'it failed just now'. Uses the Power Automate service (cs_login scope 'flow'). Unverified against a live tenant.

clientId.description: Entra app (client) id for MSAL. Defaults to CPS_CLIENT_ID, then the first-party VS Code id.

environmentId.description: Power Platform environment id (GUID). Defaults to workspace sync metadata or CPS_ENVIRONMENT_ID.

sampleFailures.description: Failed runs to open for action-level attribution; default 5

tenantId.description: Entra tenant id. Defaults to the workspace sync metadata, then CPS_TENANT_ID.

workspace.description: Path to (or inside) the agent workspace. Defaults to CPS_WORKSPACE or the current directory.

name: cs_analyze_flow_health
title: Assess a flow's reliability
